 Luka Doncic surpasses LeBron James after historic 52-point eruption for Lakers 
 2026-10-26 00:08 
 Luka Doncic passed LeBron James for sixth on the Lakers' all-time 40-point games list after his 52-point explosion in Utah.

 The Slovenian superstar erupted for another career night, dropping 52 points on a sizzling 17-of-30 shooting with 10 assists, 8 rebounds, and 2 steals in 38 minutes to lead the Lakers' 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz.
 Doncic is simply unstoppable by recording the first-ever 50-point outing of any NBA player this season, and his explosion propelled the Lakers in overcoming the Jazz' 18-point lead to win Sunday's game.
 Luka Doncic surpasses LeBron James in most 40-point games in Lakers history
 After making it through the 40-point mark for the Los Angeles Lakers against the Utah Jazz, Luka Doncic managed to surpass LeBron James in a key milestone in the franchise's history.
 Doncic has passed his former co-superstar to become sixth on the all-time list for most 40-point games in franchise history.
 Moreover, what's even remarkable is that it only took 95 games for him to reach the team's 3,000-point all-time mark.
 George Mikan, who trails Doncic on the fastest list, needed 106 games to reach the 3K club. As such, James had to play 114 games to land in the category.
 Now with a perfect 3-0 record to start their season, Doncic and the Lakers will head home to LA and face the Portland Trail Blazers next on Tuesday.
